moments.title: The Hundred Finals Day
moments.blurb: The Hundred cricket tournament culminates in its Men's and Women's Finals at Lord's on Sunday.

angles.name: Finals Hype
angles.copy: Who's lifting the trophy at Lord's tomorrow? The Hundred Finals Day is set to deliver some explosive cricket!

angles.name: Northern Teams Eliminated
angles.copy: Manchester Super Giants and Sunrisers Leeds battled in the Eliminators yesterday, but it's Trent Rockets who've booked their spot in both finals. Who are they facing?

angles.name: Weekend Sport
angles.copy: Sunday plans: sun, snacks and The Hundred finals at Lord's. Tune in to see the best of English cricket crowned champions.

moments.title: EFL New Season Kicks Off
moments.blurb: The 2026/27 EFL Championship, League One, and League Two seasons are kicking off this weekend, with matches ongoing since Friday.

angles.name: New Season Excitement
angles.copy: The new EFL season is officially underway! Who are you backing for promotion from the Championship, League One, or League Two?

angles.name: Welsh Teams in Action
angles.copy: Swansea City and Wrexham are among the Welsh teams kicking off their EFL campaigns this weekend. Big season ahead for our local clubs!

angles.name: Weekend Fixtures
angles.copy: Goals, drama, and fresh starts! Loads of EFL action across the Championship, League One & Two this weekend. Get your matchday fix!

moments.title: Lenny Kravitz at Gunnersbury Park
moments.blurb: Rock icon Lenny Kravitz is playing a major outdoor show today at Gunnersbury Park in London, as part of his 'Lenny Kravitz Live 2026' tour.

angles.name: London Rock Gig
angles.copy: Lenny Kravitz is bringing the rock 'n' roll to Gunnersbury Park in London today! Who's ready to 'Fly Away' with him?

angles.name: Classic Rock Live
angles.copy: Still got it! Lenny Kravitz is electrifying London today. An absolute legend showcasing why his live shows are unmissable.

moments.title: Ariana Grande O2 Residency
moments.blurb: Pop superstar Ariana Grande's 'The Eternal Sunshine Tour' includes a multi-night residency at London's O2 Arena, with dates today, tomorrow, and throughout next week.

angles.name: Ariana Takes London
angles.copy: London, get ready! Ariana Grande is taking over The O2 tonight and for multiple dates next week. Who's got tickets to 'The Eternal Sunshine Tour'?

angles.name: Pop Residency
angles.copy: Ariana Grande's O2 residency is in full swing! If you're heading there this weekend or next, prepare for an unforgettable night of pop perfection.

moments.title: The Weeknd at Wembley Stadium
moments.blurb: The Weeknd continues his 'After Hours Til Dawn' stadium tour with multiple dates at Wembley Stadium this weekend and next week.

angles.name: Wembley Vibes
angles.copy: Wembley Stadium is buzzing! The Weeknd is bringing his 'After Hours Til Dawn' tour to London for more dates this weekend. Who's in the crowd?

angles.name: Stadium Show
angles.copy: From 'Blinding Lights' to 'Save Your Tears', The Weeknd is delivering an epic stadium experience at Wembley. Catch him if you can!

moments.title: Madonna's 68th Birthday
moments.blurb: The Queen of Pop, Madonna, turns 68 tomorrow, August 16th.

angles.name: Happy Birthday Queen
angles.copy: Tomorrow, the one and only Madonna turns 68! Celebrate the ultimate icon with us by cranking her biggest hits all day long.

angles.name: Material Girl
angles.copy: From 'Like a Virgin' to 'Vogue', Madonna has redefined pop music for decades. Happy 68th to the legend tomorrow!

moments.title: Belinda Carlisle's 68th Birthday
moments.blurb: Go-Go's frontwoman and solo star Belinda Carlisle celebrates her 68th birthday on Monday, August 17th.

angles.name: Heaven Is A Place On Earth
angles.copy: Happy 68th Birthday on Monday to the incredible Belinda Carlisle! Still dreaming of 'Heaven Is A Place On Earth' with her hits.

angles.name: Go-Go's Legend
angles.copy: From the Go-Go's to solo success, Belinda Carlisle is a true 80s icon. Wishing her a very happy 68th on Monday!

moments.title: John Deacon's 75th Birthday
moments.blurb: Queen's legendary bassist and songwriter John Deacon turns 75 on Wednesday, August 19th.

angles.name: Queen's Bassist
angles.copy: Happy 75th Birthday to the quiet genius of Queen, John Deacon, on Wednesday! The man behind 'Another One Bites the Dust' and 'I Want To Break Free'.

angles.name: Rock Royalty
angles.copy: Celebrating John Deacon's 75th on Wednesday! His basslines are iconic, his songwriting unforgettable. A true legend of rock.

moments.title: Robert Plant's 78th Birthday

angles.name: Led Zeppelin Legend
angles.copy: Happy 78th Birthday to the golden god himself, Robert Plant, on Thursday! What's your favourite Led Zeppelin track?

angles.name: Rock Vocalist
angles.copy: Still got the voice! Wishing a very happy 78th to Robert Plant on Thursday. A true pioneer of rock and one of the greatest vocalists ever.

moments.title: We Out Here Festival in Dorset

angles.name: Sold Out Festival Vibes
angles.copy: We Out Here Festival kicks off in Dorset on Thursday! If you were lucky enough to grab a ticket, get ready for an incredible weekend of genre-hopping music.

angles.name: Gilles Peterson's Creation
angles.copy: Curated by the legendary Gilles Peterson, We Out Here is all about those jazz, soul, and electronic vibes. Who's heading to Dorset this weekend?

moments.title: Green Man Festival in Wales
moments.blurb: The independent Green Man Festival, known for its eclectic music, arts, and comedy, runs from August 20-23 in the Brecon Beacons, Wales.

angles.name: Welsh Festival Fun
angles.copy: Green Man Festival takes over the Brecon Beacons from Thursday! Get ready for an amazing blend of music, art, and good times in the heart of Wales.

angles.name: Indie & Arts
angles.copy: Beyond the music, Green Man is famous for its vibrant arts, comedy, and science stages. Kicking off on Thursday for a truly unique festival experience!

angles.name: Opening Fixture

angles.name: Pop Superstar

angles.name: Festival Lineup
angles.copy: With Charli XCX, Chase & Status, and Dave headlining, Reading & Leeds promise an epic Bank Holiday. Get ready for the biggest weekend!

angles.name: Country Star
angles.copy: Celebrating Billy Ray Cyrus's 65th on Monday! A country music staple and a pop culture icon.
